tagline: THE HOME OF 100% BRITISH, ARTISAN CHEESE & CHARCUTERIE, STYLED BEAUTIFULLY
intro: GRAPE & Fig is a sister-run grazing company based in Romford. They make sharing platters, grazing tables and on-site food displays centred on 100% British cheese and charcuterie, with ready-to-eat orders hand-delivered to most of the M25 area and Essex.
about: GRAPE & Fig is run by sisters Toria and Catherine. Toria Smith founded the company in 2017. While planning her own wedding the year before, she had wanted a four-metre grazing table to serve as canapés and starters combined. The business says it brought the concept of 'grazing' to the UK from Australia, and Catherine joined in spring 2019. Together they make sharing platters, grazing tables and styled food displays for gatherings, celebrations and brand events.

Since the start of 2022 they have used only 100% British cheese and charcuterie, sourced from small dairy farms and independent artisan producers across the UK. Every cheese or charcuterie-based platter comes with a menu and a map showing where the produce is from. The business says everything is handmade each morning in its kitchens with locally sourced, seasonal produce. The team are also trained florists and combine food and flowers in their displays.

Their own same-day, fragile-goods courier service hand-delivers ready-to-eat orders to most of the M25 area and Essex, Tuesday to Saturday. Orders can also be collected from their HQ in Romford. A £130 minimum spend applies for hand-delivery. They prefer as much notice as possible but need only 48 hours for last-minute orders, though days can close once capacity is reached. Selected gift boxes, kits and hampers ship overnight to most of mainland UK.

In 2024 the business opened what it calls the UK's first 'Build Your Own British Cheese Box Bar' on London's Regent Street. At the April 2024 launch, customers chose a box size and a base of cheese, charcuterie or vegan cheese, added condiments and built the box alongside the team. Its website advertises the bar as a seasonal summer pop-up at Brityard, 285 Regent Street.

services.name: Sharing & grazing platters
services.description: Platters including British cheese and charcuterie, vegan cheese, ploughman's, crudités and hummus, seasonal fruit and sourdough focaccia, hand-delivered to most of the M25 and Essex. The British Cheese & Charcuterie Platter is listed at £142.

services.name: Number, letter & symbol grazes
services.description: Cheese and charcuterie grazes shaped as numbers, letters or symbols, listed on their website at £149.

services.name: Grazing table styling kits
services.description: Add-on kits that turn a platter order into a grazing table. Each includes floral arrangements in vases, wooden stackers and a styling guide, all of which the customer keeps. Four sizes, advertised 'from just £108'.

services.name: Bespoke food displays & tablescaping
services.description: Food displays and tablescapes built on site, combining food, products, props and florals in 'runner' platters, abundance-style tables and bespoke setups for events, press days, brand activations and intimate gatherings. No published price.

services.name: PR mailers & brand activations
services.description: Bespoke branded mailers, grazing tables and food content for brands. Past work they list includes a launch-event grazing table, a press cheese grazing runner and pop-up picnics at Fulham Palace.

services.name: Breakfast, brunch & lunch catering
services.description: Pastry, brioche bun and bagel platters, deli pots, yoghurt and granola pots and drinks, ordered through dedicated 'For Office' and 'For Events' menus for breakfast, brunch and lunch.

areasServed: Most of mainland UK (selected postable gifts and kits only)

basedIn.text: Romford (HQ and collection point in RM1)

identity.note: An earlier directory listing gave 2014 as the founding year and a 310-312 Regent Street address, but the business says it was founded in 2017 (its limited company was incorporated in 2019) and is based in Romford, and it runs its Regent Street cheese box bar as a seasonal summer pop-up, now advertised at 285 Regent Street.

gaps: No overall 'from' or per-head price is published. Prices are listed per product (for example £142 for a cheese and charcuterie platter, £149 for a number graze, and styling kits from £108), with a £130 minimum spend for hand-delivery and £15 standard delivery.
Bespoke on-site displays have no published price, minimum booking or maximum capacity.

The business's own pages do not say whether it caters weddings or birthday parties. A 2024 press article mentions 'parties, weddings and more', and the founder's own wedding inspired the business, but the business does not list these occasions itself.
Founding year conflict: an earlier listing said 2014, but nothing supports that. The business says 2017, and Companies House shows the limited company was incorporated in 2019.
The Regent Street cheese box bar is a seasonal summer pop-up. Brityard's 2026 event listings ran to early September and no later dates were found, so current opening could not be confirmed.
Details of in-person workshops and virtual masterclasses, such as format, price and group size, could not be verified.
It is not stated whether on-site displays or setup are offered outside London, the M25 area and Essex.
No official YouTube or Vimeo channel was found, and the TikTok and Facebook content could not be read without logging in.
